title: Chirrut Îmwe
franchise: Rogue One: A Star Wars story
description: Chirrut Îmwe, from the near-extinct Guardians of the Whills, could not wield abilities in the Force, but rigorously honed his mental and physical abilities to their peak. With a deep spiritual belief in the Force, Chirrut trusts that all living things are connected through it. He joins forces with Jyn Erso, Cassian Andor, and the crew of rebels to steal the Death Star plans and save the galaxy.
